Amyl is a Black Colombian-Australian drag performer who competed on season 3 of RuPaul's Drag Race Down Under. Born in Colombia, she is now based in Sydney.
Early life
Amyl was born in Colombia.
Career
Amyl has been a part of the drag scene since 2019. She competed on season 3 of RuPaul's Drag Race Down Under. She was the first contestant to be eliminated from the competition. She was also a runway model at Australian Fashion Week in 2021 and 2023.
Personal life
Amyl is based in Sydney. Amyl uses the pronouns she/her in drag and he/they'' out of drag.
